title: Mountain Peak Identification
description:
You are given an array that follows a "mountain" pattern: it strictly increases to a maximum value at some index i and then strictly decreases. Your task is to find the index i of this peak element. Your solution must have a time complexity of O(log n).

Example 1
Input:
arr = [0,1,0]
Output:
1

Example 2
Input:
arr = [0,2,1,0]
Output:
1

Example 3
Input:
arr = [0,10,5,2]
Output:
1
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n representing the size of the array.
The second line contains n space-separated integers representing the mountain array elements.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the zero-indexed position of the peak element.
constraints:
3 <= n <= 100000
0 <= arr[i] <= 1000000
arr is guaranteed to be a valid mountain array
